criteria.no: No single method is stated to check every bead in the phase, including when validation is not discussed, is discussed only generally, is split across methods, or skips some beads.
criteria.unclear: A phase validation method is mentioned but its coverage of every bead is not determinable.
criteria.yes: One method, function, command or entry point is stated to check every bead, all beads, or the whole phase.

addressed.instructions: Does `item.text` say that one validation method checks every bead in the phase? A single method that uses a different model per bead kind counts as one method. Judge presence only.

criteria.no: Nothing in the item conflicts with one method validating every bead in the phase.
criteria.unclear: It cannot be determined whether the item splits validation or skips beads of the phase.
criteria.yes: The item splits validation across separate methods with none covering every bead of the phase, or skips some bead or bead kind of the phase.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` rule out one validation method validating every bead in the phase? Silence is not a conflict, and excluding beads of other phases is not a conflict. Judge conflict only.

criteria.no: No, the item is about another part of the system.
criteria.unclear: The item is too vague to tell.
criteria.yes: Yes, the item works on bead validation or bead schemas.

relevant.instructions: Is `item.text` about validating atm-bd-orchestration beads (bead schemas, bead models, a validator or validation command, or which beads get checked)? Judge subject only.

anchor.statement: A single validation method must validate every bead in the phase.

item.text: Add `validate_phase()`, which walks every bead under the phase epic and checks each one against the pydantic model for its bead kind (sprint, dev, fix, sanity, qa, stack).
